unit.title: Numbers to 20
unit.blurb: Counting, reading and ordering numbers to 20; teen numbers as ten and some more; first, second and third.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Read, count and show numbers from 11 to 20 as ten and some more.

O2.t: Compare and order numbers to 20 and use first, second, third.

p: **Teen numbers** are **ten** and some more. 13 is ten and three. 17 is ten and seven. A full ten frame shows the ten.
The 1 in 14 means one ten. The 4 means four ones. Fourteen = ten and four.

p: On a number line the numbers get **bigger** as we go **right**. 18 is bigger than 12 because it is further along.
In a race the winner is **first**. Next is **second**, then **third**, **fourth** and **fifth**.

options.fb: 12 comes before 18.
Correct.
